skills.name: Flame Elemental
skills.description: Use Blaze Wizard's direct skill attack to temporarily summon a Flame Elemental which will increase your Magic ATT.

skills.name: Fire Repulsion
skills.description: The flow of flames repulses some of the damage from the caster.

skills.name: Natural Talent
skills.description: Increases your max MP through natural talent. Amount increased depends on your level.

skills.name: Orbital Flame
skills.description: Scorch enemies by kindling a flame that flies a certain distance in front and then returns. Use the arrow keys to direct the flame.

skills.name: Orbital Flame
skills.description: Scorch enemies by kindling a flame that flies a certain distance in front and then returns. Use the arrow keys to direct the flame. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Flame Bite
skills.description: Sends out a jet of flame to burn enemies in front of you. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Firewalk
skills.description:
Jump into the air and disappear in a burst of flames, reappearing some distance ahead. Permanently raises your Defense, Speed, and Jump.
Replaces Elemental Shift.

skills.name: Firewalk
skills.description:
Jump into the air and disappear in a burst of flames, reappearing some distance ahead. Permanently raises your Defense, Jump, and Max Speed.
Replaces Elemental Shift.

skills.name: Greater Orbital Flame
skills.description: Enhances the damage of Orbital Flame. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Orbital Explosion
skills.description:
Harness and release the essence of the flame.
When Orbital Flame, Phoenix Drive, Orbital Inferno, Inferno Sphere, or Eternity land a certain number of times, the next attack will be an additional fire-attribute flame energy hit.
nThe flame energy hits are unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills.

skills.name: Greater Flame Elemental
skills.description: Enhances Flame Elemental.

skills.name: Spell Control
skills.description: Pushes your magical skills to the limit through intense focus, giving you greater control over magic itself.

skills.name: Greater Orbital Flame
skills.description: Enhances the damage of Orbital Flame.

skills.name: Word of Fire
skills.description: Call on the hidden words of fire to increase Magic ATT, Attack Speed, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Flame Vortex
skills.description: Burns enemies and pushes them back with swirling flames. Can be resisted by some enemies. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Controlled Burn
skills.description:
Recover from the heat of battle and convert your internal flame to MP.
Absorb the enemy's MP when attacking with flame Magic skills. Absorption efficiency is reduced against bosses, resulting in less MP gained.

skills.name: Flashfire
skills.description:
Leave a trail of fire from your current location. While the trail remains, you can use Flashfire again to teleport back to your original position.
Use the skill with the down key to leave a trail of fire again.

skills.name: Grand Orbital Flame
skills.description:
Enhances the damage of Orbital Flame. 
Your proficiency with Fire magic increases after using it a certain number of times, and you will be able to summon an enhanced Orbital Flame. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Grand Flame Elemental
skills.description: Enhances Greater Flame Elemental.

skills.name: Liberated Magic
skills.description: Liberates the flame-flow from within you, allowing it to grow in power.

skills.name: Burning Focus
skills.description: Critically analyzes enemy weaknesses and increases the chance of landing fatal blows.

skills.name: Brilliant Enlightenment
skills.description: Reach enlightenment through command of magic.

skills.name: Grand Orbital Flame
skills.description: Enhances the damage of Orbital Flame.

skills.name: Grand Orbital Flame
skills.description: You get used to the Fire magic and launch enhanced Orbital Flame. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Flame Tempest
skills.description: Damages and pushes enemies away from both sides of the caster with huge, surging flames. Can be resisted by some enemies. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Cinder Maelstrom
skills.description:
Manifests a flame imbued with the power of the phoenix and binds enemies by immobilizing them.
Enemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, such as Cinder Maelstrom. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Phoenix Run
skills.description:
When hit by a fatal attack, saves you by moving backwards and healing a percentage of HP through the blessing of fire.
Not affected by Cooldown reset.

skills.name: Phoenix Run
skills.description:

 Not affected by Cooldown reset.

skills.name: Blazing Blitz
skills.description: Blazes forward in a burst of fire, leaving a trail inextinguishable flame in your path. A fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Final Orbital Flame
skills.description:
Enhances the damage of Orbital Flame.
You have mastered Fire magic and can summon an enhanced Orbital Flame. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Final Flame Elemental
skills.description: Enhances Grand Flame Elemental and permanently increases Magic ATT.

skills.name: Wild Blaze
skills.description: Summon roaring flames to burn enemies.

skills.name: Pure Magic
skills.description: Unleashes the very essence of your magic, releasing all your magical potential at once.

skills.name: Final Orbital Flame
skills.description:
Enhances damage and allows up to 4 uses of Orbital Flame. Press the arrow keys with the skill key to direct the attack.
Required Skill: Grand Orbital Flame Lv. 20

skills.name: Blazing Extinction
skills.description: Launches an intense flame sphere that burns nearby enemies with seeking chains of fire.

skills.name: Fires of Creation
skills.description: Summons the very essence of fire itself from the elemental world. While summoned, your MP costs increase but your attacks ignore some enemy defenses.

skills.name: Fires of Creation
skills.description: Summons the very essence of fire itself from the elemental world. While summoned, your MP costs increase but your attacks ignore some enemy defenses and change the attack method of Orbital Flame.

skills.name: Final Orbital Flame

skills.name: Final Orbital Flame
skills.description: Borrows power from the mischievous Flame Fox to launch a flame in front that doesn't return. Using it a certain number of times allows you to summon an enhanced Orbital Flame. Use the arrow keys to direct the skill. This is a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Final Orbital Flame
skills.description: Borrows power from the mischievous Flame Fox to launch a flame in front that doesn't return. Using it a certain number of times allows you to summon an enhanced Orbital Flame. Use the arrow keys to direct the skill.

skills.name: Towering Inferno
skills.description:
The Flame Fox temporarily returns to a state of pure fire and throws multiple flames in front.
Towering Inferno Fox Mode cooldown decreases every time your attack lands.
Using it while pressing the down arrow key activates Towering Inferno Lion Mode. When the command is locked, Towering Inferno Lion Mode will not activate even when used while pressing the down arrow key.
Towering Inferno is not affected by cooldown reset effects.
This is a fire-attribute attack. Can be used only when Flame Fox is summoned.
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Orbital Flame - Guardbreak
skills.description: Grants Orbital Flame a bonus to Enemy DEF Ignored.

skills.name: Orbital Flame - Split Attack
skills.description: Increases Number of Attacks while decreasing Final Orbital Flame's damage.

skills.name: Blazing Extinction - Add Attack
skills.description: Increases Blazing Extinction's attack count.

skills.name: Blazing Extinction - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Blazing Extinction.

skills.name: Blazing Extinction - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Blazing Extinction.

skills.name: Orbital Explosion - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Orbital Explosion.

skills.name: Orbital Explosion - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate of Orbital Explosion.

skills.name: Orbital Explosion - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Enemy Defense for Orbital Explosion.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Blazing Extinction
skills.description:
Launches an intense flame sphere that burns nearby enemies with seeking chains of fire.
Using it while pressing the down arrow key will activate Blazing Extinction Fox Mode. When the command is locked, Blazing Extinction Fox Mode will not activate even when used while pressing the down arrow key.
Can only be used while Blazing Lion is summoned.
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Towering Inferno
skills.description:
Concentrates the flow of flames into a single spot. Using it while pressing the down arrow key activates Towering Inferno Fox Mode. When the command is locked, Towering Inferno Fox Mode will not activate even when used while pressing the down arrow key.
Towering Inferno is not affected by cooldown reset effects.
This is a fire-attribute attack. Can only be used when Blazing Lion is summoned.
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Flame Barrier
skills.description: Summons a powerful wall of flames to defend against debilitating status conditions. Unaffected by buff duration increases.

skills.name: Fires of Creation
skills.description:
Summons the very essence of fire itself. Using this skill will call forth Blazing Lion. Using the skill again will call forth Flame Fox.
While summoning is in effect, your MP costs increase, but a portion of enemy defense is ignored.
The attack varies upon using Orbital Flame, Towering Inferno, Blazing Extinction, or Savage Flame based on the Fire Essence summoned.

skills.name: Burning Conduit
skills.description: Creates a pentacle on the ground, increasing the damage and attack speed of everyone standing on it. You, and only you, can also receive the effects outside the pentacle. Using the Burning Conduit where the first effect was received will not renew the effect.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Burning Conduit

skills.name: Blazing Extinction
skills.description:
The playful Flame Fox condenses incredible heat to create a Flaming Orb, then spits a torrent of heat forward for a set amount of time.
Using it while pressing the down arrow key activates Blazing Extinction Lion Mode. When the command is locked, Blazing Extinction Lion Mode will not activate even when used while pressing the down arrow key.
This is a fire attack. Cooldown reset effects do not apply.
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Orbital Flame - Range
skills.description:
Increases movement range of Orbital Flame.
Can be toggled On/Off with the skill key.

skills.name: Cataclysm
skills.description: Summons a giant flame to fall on enemies around you. The flame bursts as it hits the ground and burns all nearby enemies. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Glory of the Guardians
skills.description: A ceremony for Cygnus Knights to pledge their devotion to the Empress.

skills.name: Phoenix Drive

skills.name: Inferno Sphere
skills.description: Blaze through your enemies with the phoenix's symbol of infinite life and death. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. It's a fire-attribute attack.

skills.name: Eternity
skills.description:
The phoenix that rules over the cycle of life and death manifests, bringing death to all. The phoenix creates a Flame of the Cycle on the ground for a certain period of time.

Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%
